declaredOptions.label: RTP folders
declaredOptions.description: Extra folders mounted into the game's file system so RTP assets resolve. Read as the mkxp.json key RTP (src/config.cpp:340).

declaredOptions.label: Patch folders
declaredOptions.description: Folders mounted over the game's own files, so a mod or translation can replace assets and scripts without touching the game (src/config.cpp:341).

declaredOptions.label: Ruby load paths
declaredOptions.description: Folders appended to Ruby's $LOAD_PATH before the game starts (src/config.cpp:351).

declaredOptions.label: Custom script file
declaredOptions.description: Ruby script run instead of the game's own script bundle. A file path, relative to the game folder (src/config.cpp:334).

declaredOptions.label: Preload script files
declaredOptions.description: Ruby script files run before the game's scripts. File paths, relative to the game folder (src/config.cpp:338).

declaredOptions.label: Postload script files
declaredOptions.description: Ruby script files run after the game's scripts (src/config.cpp:339).

declaredOptions.label: RGSS version
declaredOptions.description: Forces the RGSS version: 0 detects it from the game, 1 is XP, 2 is VX, 3 is VX Ace (src/config.cpp:272).

declaredOptions.label: Fullscreen
declaredOptions.description: Starts the game fullscreen (src/config.cpp:293).

declaredOptions.label: Keep aspect ratio
declaredOptions.description: Letterboxes rather than stretching the game to the screen (src/config.cpp:294).

declaredOptions.label: Upscaling filter
declaredOptions.description: Filter used when the game is scaled up: 0 nearest neighbour, 1 bilinear, 2 bicubic, 3 Lanczos3 (src/config.cpp:295, src/etc/etc.h:205).

declaredOptions.label: Integer scaling
declaredOptions.description: Scales only by whole multiples, keeping pixels square (src/config.cpp:323).

declaredOptions.label: High-resolution rendering
declaredOptions.description: Renders above the game's native resolution; costs memory and speed (src/config.cpp:304).

declaredOptions.label: Texture scaling factor
declaredOptions.description: Multiplier applied to textures when high-resolution rendering is on (src/config.cpp:305).

declaredOptions.label: Vertical sync
declaredOptions.description: Synchronises presentation with the display refresh (src/config.cpp:309).

declaredOptions.label: Frame rate cap
declaredOptions.description: Caps the frame rate; 0 leaves the game's own rate alone. Passed to mkxp-z as fixedFramerate (src/config.cpp:311).

declaredOptions.label: Frame skipping
declaredOptions.description: Lets the engine drop frames to keep game time correct when it cannot keep up (src/config.cpp:312).

declaredOptions.label: Window width
declaredOptions.description: Starting width in pixels; 0 uses the RGSS default for the game's version (src/config.cpp:273).

declaredOptions.label: Window height
declaredOptions.description: Starting height in pixels; 0 uses the RGSS default for the game's version (src/config.cpp:274).

declaredOptions.label: MIDI SoundFont file
declaredOptions.description: SoundFont file used to play the game's MIDI music. A file path (src/config.cpp:329).

declaredOptions.label: Fonts drawn without anti-aliasing
declaredOptions.description: Font names that must be rendered with hard pixel edges, as pixel-art fonts expect (src/config.cpp:314, Config::fontIsSolid).

declaredOptions.label: Font substitutions
declaredOptions.description: Replacements for fonts the game asks for but the device lacks, each written as 'missing>replacement' (src/config.cpp:342, src/display/font.cpp:158).

declaredOptions.label: Allow the F1 settings menu
declaredOptions.description: Enables mkxp-z's own settings menu during play (src/config.cpp:328, src/eventthread.cpp:343).

declaredOptions.label: Allow F12 reset
declaredOptions.description: Enables the engine's reset key (src/config.cpp:327, src/eventthread.cpp:398).

declaredOptions.label: Follow symbolic links
declaredOptions.description: Lets the game's file system follow symbolic links, which some repacked games rely on (src/config.cpp:265, src/filesystem/filesystem.cpp:315).
